subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this reaction-specific issue separate until live current-main Slack envelopes identify the first drop boundary, or fold it into the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery tracking?
rationale: The code has handler support and related routing fixes, but only a live Slack/Bolt envelope or trace can prove whether the remaining failure is reaction-specific filtering, Socket Mode delivery, or broader liveness.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Tracking
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove Socket Mode failure until redacted live current-main diagnostics identify the drop point.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Socket Mode Tracking
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 only if maintainers obtain diagnostics showing the same non-reaction-specific root cause.

options.title: Close After Live Pass
options.body: Close only after a live current-main multi-account Slack run proves reaction add/remove envelopes are delivered and routed.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Tracking
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove Socket Mode failure until redacted live current-main diagnostics identify the drop point.
